$comment: Hand-marked faces for the meco-faces detect test. Boxes are fractions of
the image, 0..1 from the top-left, in the same shape POST /detect returns.
Marked by eye against the fixture at full size, drawn back over the photo
and corrected until every rectangle framed the face from hairline to chin
and ear to ear. They are a human's answer, not a detector's — the point of
the test is that the two agree.
tolerance is the largest allowed difference in any single coordinate,
expressed as a fraction of the image, per the ticket's '3 %'.
person is which human is in the face, for the embed test: two faces sharing
a letter are the same person in two photographs, and two faces with
different letters are different people. It is a letter and not a name
because a fixture is not an enrolled Person and must not read like one.

images.note: Four faces at four scales and two rows — the group case.
One large, well-lit face — the single-Subject case.
Person A again, four years earlier: different photographer, clothing, lighting and background, and a face an eighth the width of the other portrait's. The same-person case the embed test needs.
No face at all. Rock and shadow, which is where a detector invents one if it is going to.
